name: Cari Layanan
desc_id: Direktori krisis untuk penyintas kekerasan berbasis gender selama COVID-19. Saya bangun direktori WordPress yang memetakan layanan terverifikasi berdasarkan lokasi dan kebutuhan — rahasia, langsung bisa diakses, dan menskala hingga ribuan pengguna.
desc_en: A crisis directory for survivors of gender-based violence during COVID-19. I built a WordPress directory mapping verified services by location and need — confidential, immediately accessible, and able to scale to thousands of users.
